title: デッド・データ・オアシス
author: ネオン 零

en.title: Dead Data Oasis
en.premise: In a world where memories are bought and sold like common commodities, I make a living as a Memory Scavenger. But everything changes when I scavenge a memory from a corpse—a vision of a desert oasis teeming with 'real greenery.' It is the coordinate to Earth's final sanctuary, a secret the corporations have gone to great lengths to bury. Now, hunted by corporate 'Cleaners,' I must dive into forbidden data, risking the total burnout of my brain to uncover the truth.

zh.title: 死亡数据绿洲
zh.premise: 在这个记忆买卖已成日常的世界中，我是一名靠捡拾记忆为生的“记忆拾荒者”。直到有一天，我从一具尸体中发现了一段特殊的记忆——那是关于一片拥有“真正绿意”的沙漠绿洲。那竟是企业一直极力掩盖的、地球最后的圣域坐标。在企业“清道夫”的步步紧逼下，我必须冒着大脑被烧毁的生命危险，向禁忌的数据深处发起潜入。
